points.description: Every step is mathematically valid (uses conditional probability: P(75→90)=P(75→80)·P(80→90), and P(75→85)=P(75→80)·P(80→85)) with no incorrect step, and the final answer is 5/8 (= 0.625 = 62.5%). Any wrong step or wrong final answer earns 0.

rubric.notes: Full mark only if all reasoning is valid and the final answer is 5/8 (0.625, 62.5%). Any invalid step or incorrect final answer earns no marks. No part marks.
rubric.answer_key: Let x = P(75-year-old lives to 80). Living 15 more years means reaching 80 and then living 10 more: 0.2 = x·0.25, so x = 0.8. Living 10 more years from 75 means reaching 85 = reaching 80 and then living 5 more: 0.5 = x·p, so p = 0.5/0.8 = 0.625. Final answer: 5/8 = 0.625 = 62.5%.
